steps.eval: (()=>{const g=__rhf.game; const p=g.world.place('glacier'); const c=g.calving; if(!c.ok) return 'no front'; g.player.place(p.x,p.z,0); g.env.setTime(13); const e=g.camera.position; g.player.yaw=Math.atan2(-(c.center.x-p.x),-(c.center.z-p.z)); g.player.pitch=0.08; return 'front pts '+c.front.length+' center '+c.center.x.toFixed(0)+','+c.center.z.toFixed(0)+' top '+c.center.top.toFixed(1)+' back '+c.center.back+' dist '+Math.hypot(c.center.x-p.x,c.center.z-p.z).toFixed(0)})()

(()=>{const c=__rhf.game.calving; c.timer=999; for(let i=0;i<10;i++){ c.calve(); const p=c.pieces[c.pieces.length-1]; if(p.big) return 'big slab w '+p.w.toFixed(1)+' h '+p.h.toFixed(1)+' d '+p.d.toFixed(1)+' lean '+p.theta.toFixed(2); c.removePiece(c.pieces.length-1);} return 'no big'})()

(async()=>{const c=__rhf.game.calving; for(let i=0;i<900;i++){ const p=c.pieces[c.pieces.length-1]; if(p && p.phase==='topple' && p.theta>0.35) return 'topple theta '+p.theta.toFixed(2); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,30)); } return 'no topple'})()

(async()=>{const c=__rhf.game.calving; for(let i=0;i<900;i++){ const p=c.pieces[c.pieces.length-1]; if(p && p.phase==='berg') return 'impact at '+p.pos.x.toFixed(0)+','+p.pos.y.toFixed(1)+','+p.pos.z.toFixed(0); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,20)); } return 'no impact'})()

(()=>{const c=__rhf.game.calving; const p=c.pieces[c.pieces.length-1]; return 'berg y '+(p.pos.y-c.level).toFixed(2)+' theta '+p.theta.toFixed(2)+' ext '+c.extent(p).toFixed(1)+' vel '+p.vel.x.toFixed(2)+','+p.vel.z.toFixed(2)})()

(()=>{const c=__rhf.game.calving; for(let i=0;i<12;i++){ c.calve(); const p=c.pieces[c.pieces.length-1]; if(!p.big) return 'chunk h '+p.h.toFixed(1); c.removePiece(c.pieces.length-1);} return 'no chunk'})()

(async()=>{const c=__rhf.game.calving; for(let i=0;i<900;i++){ const p=c.pieces[c.pieces.length-1]; if(p && p.phase==='fall' && p.t>0.4) return 'falling y '+(p.pos.y-c.level).toFixed(1); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,30)); } return 'no fall'})()
